errors.text_span: 图表的x轴为“关键词数量”
errors.evidence: The description invents an overall label for the x-axis, "关键词数量" (Number of keywords), which is not present in the figure. The x-axis only has categorical labels.
The visible range of the y-axis is from 30 to 100, not 0 to 100.
The y-axis tick marks are at 30, 44, 58, 72, 86, and 100, which represents an interval of 14, not 10.
The description uses the awkward and non-standard term "柱状线" (columnar lines) to refer to the bars. While the meaning can be inferred, standard terminology would be "条形" or "柱形" (bars/columns).
